Monica Nyambura  
📞 +91 98765 43210 | 📧 monica.nyambura@securesphere.in | 📍 Bengaluru, Karnataka

Professional Experience  
As a Senior Cybersecurity Tech Lead & Architect at SecureSphere Technologies, I have orchestrated the evolution of security operations from a fragmented silo to a unified, scalable infrastructure serving over 500 customers. My tenure at SecureSphere has centered on reducing cloud security vulnerabilities by 65% through automated compliance checks, a feat achieved by integrating real-time policy enforcement with continuous monitoring. Prior to this, at CipherShield Labs, I architected a zero-trust framework that ensured 99.999% uptime for SOC infrastructure, a critical milestone in maintaining operational resilience during a global cybersecurity surge. Earlier, as a Cybersecurity Analyst at QuantumGuard Solutions, I led incident response for 30+ breaches, slashing mean time to detect (MTTD) by 40% through SIEM automation, which streamlined threat triage and minimized dwell time. These roles have solidified my ability to translate complex security challenges into actionable, measurable outcomes.  

Technical Skills  
My technical expertise spans designing and deploying security architectures that align with enterprise-scale demands. I have deep experience in system design, having engineered solutions that balance proactive threat detection with minimal operational overhead. My proficiency in Linux administration is evident in the automation of server hardening processes, which reduced manual configuration time by 30% across distributed environments. Monitoring & alerting frameworks like Prometheus and Grafana are integral to my workflow, enabling real-time visibility into system health and anomaly detection. Database optimization is a recurring focus, particularly in refining query performance for log analysis pipelines, which improved data retrieval efficiency by 25%.  

Technical writing is a cornerstone of my practice, as evidenced by the creation of standardized playbooks that reduced onboarding time for new team members by 40%. These documents are now foundational to cross-team collaboration, ensuring alignment on incident response protocols. Agile/Scrum methodologies are embedded in my daily operations, with a particular emphasis on sprint planning that prioritizes high-impact security initiatives. Code review is a critical process I oversee, ensuring architectural decisions adhere to security best practices while fostering innovation. Cross-team collaboration is central to my approach, as seen in the integration of DevOps pipelines with security controls, which minimized vulnerabilities in CI/CD workflows.  

Mentoring has been a key focus, with a structured program that has upskilled 12 junior engineers in threat modeling and secure coding practices. Project management is woven into every phase of my work, from defining scope for compliance audits to ensuring timely delivery of security enhancements. Risk assessment is a recurring activity, particularly in evaluating the impact of new technologies on existing infrastructure. Stakeholder communication is vital, as I regularly present technical findings to non-technical audiences, translating complex data into strategic insights.  

Education  
Master of Science in Cybersecurity, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), 2018.

- **Cloud Compliance Automation**: Developed a suite of automated compliance checks at SecureSphere Technologies, reducing cloud security vulnerabilities by 65% and improving audit readiness.  
- **SIEM Automation Optimization**: Engineered SIEM workflows at QuantumGuard Solutions, reducing MTTD by 40% and enabling faster threat detection through rule-based automation.
